result_rule: Reject if either ON has zero witness_ok/published_records/exact records/basis, or an unsupported witness/recipe/cull/resource/COLOR path publishes. All publication still follows layer/hit_material.cpp unchanged policy. Zero publication is a candidate rejection, not a quality pass. Missing producers/readiness/captures are INVALID. Require conservative null mean energy within same-run OFF-repeat Student/Bonferroni noise (m4_promotion_gate --pool run); no arbitrary positive-energy allowance. Inspect same-exposure images for improved correct material detail and no leaks, substitution or regression. Any resolved mean shift requires a matched PT explanation before promotion; this job alone cannot authorize it. Report every ON cost vs its neighbouring OFF windows; useful correctness is not rejected for cost alone.
window_bound: Shared live_flow retime: 120-frame publication and 300-frame cost producers. Finite readiness caps: warmup 180 s, changed states 60 s each; global job timeout 850 s and max_minutes 15. No compilation/diagnostics in cost windows.
offline_status: Prepared with shared retime; fresh lint/dryrun receipts listed in README. No game launched.

readback_budget.oversize: Explicitly unsupported above the bounded raw job capacity; no GPU wait. Larger-than-frame ranges progress in chunks.
readback_budget.source_policy: Raw float3 positions and half2/float2 UVs; mapped mutable buffers remain unknown. Source writes/reuse invalidate per-witness proof and dependent records.

deciding_observable: Positive exact witnessed publication and verified basis in both S6 ON windows; same-run image/energy and full GPU timers.
coverage: Full witness/COLOR/resource/recipe/cull/basis are existing publication prerequisites, not UV-count proxies. Both ON diag windows require witness_ok >0, published_records >0, exact >0, records >0 and basis ready >0. Rejection counters may be positive for unsupported candidates; do not require all scene candidates to qualify.
